dct_title_s: Plan of the southern portion of the province of South Australia as divided into counties and hundreds : showing agricultural settlements, post towns, telegraph stations, main roads, railways
dct_description_sm: Compiled in the office of the Surveyor General ; Frazer S. Crawford, Photo-lithographer.
Inset map showing Robinson county (western continuation of main map).
Shows various roads, locations (stations, post offices, water sources, etc.), places names (hills, waterways, etc.).
